pack.name: Neonfall
pack.description: Rain never stops in Vesper Arc. A ghost of the Lattice, a chrome gang boss and a corporate security chief fight for the drowned megacity in 60 original cards.

GUARD.name: Firewall
GUARD.tip: Enemies must attack minions with Firewall first.

HASTE.name: Overclock
HASTE.tip: Can attack the turn it is played.

BARRIER.name: Hardlight
BARRIER.tip: The first time it would take damage, it takes none and loses Hardlight.

STEALTH.name: Cloak
STEALTH.tip: Can't be attacked or targeted until it attacks.

SPELLPROOF.name: Encrypted
SPELLPROOF.tip: Can't be targeted by spells or Champion Powers.

ON_PLAY.name: Boot
ON_PLAY.tip: Does something when you play it from your hand.

WOUNDED.name: Redline
WOUNDED.tip: Has an extra effect while damaged.

COMBO.name: Chain
COMBO.tip: A bonus if you already played a card this turn.

MANA_LOCK.name: Heat
MANA_LOCK.tip: Heat (X): you have X less Mana next turn.

TRAP.name: Protocol
TRAP.tip: Hidden until it triggers on your opponent's turn.

SILENCE.name: Wipe
SILENCE.tip: Removes all card text and enchantments from a minion.

FREEZE.name: Jam
FREEZE.tip: A Jammed character misses its next attack.

SPELL_POWER.name: Bandwidth
SPELL_POWER.tip: Your spells deal X more damage.

ARMOR.name: Plating
ARMOR.tip: Absorbs damage to your champion before Health.

FATIGUE.name: Data Rot
FATIGUE.tip: Drawing from an empty deck deals growing damage to your champion.

iris_null.name: Iris Null
iris_null.text: Ghost. She rides the Lattice and leaves no trace.

mother_rust.name: Mother Rust
mother_rust.text: Chromehead. Boss of the Rust Saints; her arm settles every argument.

director_vale.name: Director Vale
director_vale.text: Executive. Security chief of Sunvault Consolidated; everything is an asset.

siphon.name: Siphon

shakedown.name: Shakedown

ghostwalk.name: Ghostwalk

cache_raid.name: Cache Raid

signal_leech.name: Signal Leech

static_lock.name: Static Lock

lattice_diver.name: Lattice Diver
lattice_diver.text: Cloak. Chain: Return an enemy minion that costs (3) or less to its owner's hand.

firmware_rot.name: Firmware Rot
firmware_rot.text: Wipe a minion, then deal $2 damage to it.

corrupt.name: Corrupt

packet_storm.name: Packet Storm

recursive_hound.name: Recursive Hound

root_access.name: Root Access

rust_shiv.name: Rust Shiv

nitro_shot.name: Nitro Shot
nitro_shot.text: Give a friendly minion +2 Attack and Overclock. Heat (1)

chrome_up.name: Chrome Up

bitrot_daemon.name: Bit-Rot Daemon

black_market_broker.name: Black Market Broker
black_market_broker.text: Boot: Add a random class card to your hand.

lattice_phantom.name: Lattice Phantom
lattice_phantom.text: Cloak. At the end of your turn, Jam a random enemy minion.

billboard_leviathan.text: Firewall. At the end of your turn, deal 1 damage to all enemy minions.

varga.name: Dr. Lucent Varga

last_free_mind.name: The Last Free Mind
last_free_mind.text: Encrypted. At the end of your turn, transform a random enemy minion into a 0/3 Glitch with Firewall.
